title: Gateway errors with no obvious gateway problem
query: Users keep saying checkout fails every so often and our gateway error graph has crept up, but the gateway logs don't show a bug of its own. Where do I start?
root_cause: A regression in the new payments release makes some charge requests raise an unhandled error.

remediation.detail: Roll payments back to the previous version (v1.0.0).

evidence: Gateway logs only show orders call failed
Following one request id shows the failure originates in payments
Payments logs show a KeyError and a recent version change
